summary: This directory centralizes the definition of CRUD schemas for the core business (gyomu) domain. It acts as the single source of truth for the data structures and validation rules required for managing application services, tasks, milestones, and status tracking information.
responsibilities: Define CRUD operation schemas for application business entities
Specify structural validation rules for domain-specific data models
Maintain consistent interface definitions for service and task-related information
relationships: The CRUD schemas define the shape of data models used across various task and service management modules.
Business entities are represented as validated schema objects to ensure data integrity during system operations.
designDecisions: Declarative schema modeling for CRUD operations
Domain-driven grouping of related business entity schemas
